headline: Strong operating growth; net income boosted by one-time gain
summary_short: Revenue rose 12% y/y to $14.19B on Gross Bookings +24% and Trips +18%, while GAAP net income jumped 77% to $2.39B — boosted by a $1.6B pre-tax gain on equity-investment revaluations — and diluted EPS rose to $1.17.
summary_long: Q2 revenue grew 12% y/y to $14.19B (11% constant currency), held back 8 points by business-model changes; Gross Bookings grew 24% to $58.0B on Trips +18% and MAPCs +16%. GAAP operating income rose 30% to $1.89B; Non-GAAP Operating Income rose 40% to $2.14B (3.7% of Gross Bookings, up from 3.3%). Net income rose 77% to $2.39B, boosted by a $1.6B pre-tax gain on equity-investment revaluations; diluted EPS rose to $1.17 from $0.63. Adjusted EBITDA rose 33% to $2.82B. Cash fell to $4.87B from $7.11B at year-end after a $1.6B total-return-swap purchase; buybacks were $518M. Q3 outlook: Gross Bookings $58.25-60.25B, Non-GAAP EPS $0.84-0.88.

drivers.explanation: Company attributes growth to Gross Bookings +24% YoY (22% constant currency) on Trips +18% and MAPCs +16%; total revenue growth was held back 8 points YoY by business-model changes.

Release ties the gain to Gross Bookings scale; Non-GAAP Operating Income (excludes legal/regulatory reserve changes, acquisition costs, restructuring) grew faster than GAAP, up 40% to $2.14B versus GAAP's 30%.
Company states GAAP net income included a $1.6B pre-tax net benefit from revaluations of Uber's equity investments, versus a $17M headwind a year ago — the primary driver of the 77% jump.
Tracks the net-income jump; diluted share count fell 3.5% y/y (2,050M vs 2,126M) on continued buybacks, adding a small extra lift to per-share growth beyond the net-income growth rate.

This shard KPI is EBIT (pretax income + interest expense) plus D&A, which embeds the $1.6B equity-investment gain; it is not the company's own 'Adjusted EBITDA' (+33% to $2.82B), which explicitly excludes that gain.

CEO Dara Khosrowshahi framed results as compounding platform advantage and record engagement; CFO Balaji Krishnamurthy cited trailing-twelve-month free cash flow exceeding $10B for the first time, funding investment while reducing share count.
